CHAPTER 7 · ITEM 06 / 10

Efficiency and welfare

Total surplus總剩餘

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Calculate total surplus as consumer surplus plus producer surplus, or buyers' total value minus sellers' total cost in an untaxed market.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

無稅市場內，買方付款等於賣方收入，兩者相加抵消；總剩餘是買方總價值減賣方總機會成本。

In an untaxed market, payments transfer value between buyer and seller. Adding CS and PS cancels the payment, leaving total value to buyers minus total opportunity cost to sellers.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：WTP=20, price=12, cost=7. CS=8, PS=5, total=13=20−7. 價格影響分配但這筆交易總收益為十三。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

WTP=30, price=18, cost=10. Total surplus? 總剩餘？
